therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Microtubule stabilization (docetaxel) and DNA intercalation/topoisomerase II inhibition (doxorubicin) combined with DNA alkylation (cyclophosphamide)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation inhibition and apoptosis induction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Breast cancer patients receiving adjuvant treatment

subgroup_findings: HR+ HER2+ subgroup: 6 vs 6 events (TAC vs FAC)
HR+ HER2- subgroup: 37 vs 50 events (TAC vs FAC)
HR- HER2+ subgroup: 5 vs 6 events (TAC vs FAC)
HR- HER2- subgroup: 28 vs 29 events (TAC vs FAC)
safety_signals: Grade 3-4 AEs: 151 vs 88 patients (TAC vs FAC)
Serious AEs: 119 vs 22 patients (TAC vs FAC)
Treatment discontinuation due to AE: 25 vs 4 patients (TAC vs FAC)
Death due to AE: 1 vs 0 patients (TAC vs FAC)
results.dose_information: Standard adjuvant chemotherapy regimens administered over average 4 months
